title: Oliver Otter and the Pebble Song
description: Oliver Otter is worried his musical pebble toss sounds silly until he hears how happy it makes the river forest.
character_reference: a playful young sea otter with glossy chocolate-brown fur, a creamy white chest, and bright cheerful eyes

scenes.narration: Oliver sat on a smooth river rock, clutching three shiny flat pebbles in his paws. He loved making music where the water rippled.
scenes.visual: A young otter sitting on a mossy rock by a gently flowing river, holding smooth stones, dappled sunlight shimmering on the water surface.

scenes.narration: He tossed one small stone into the stream, listening to the soft plip sound. But then he stopped, worrying it sounded too quiet.
scenes.visual: Close up of an otter looking down doubtfully at ripples spreading across clear blue water, thoughtful expression, soft focus background.

scenes.narration: What if the frogs and fish think my song is silly? he murmured, pulling his paws back into his lap.
scenes.visual: An otter hugging his knees on a riverbank, looking down shyly, gentle watercolor style illustration, warm afternoon lighting.

scenes.narration: A green frog popped up from the reeds nearby, blinking its large golden eyes and smiling a wide, welcoming smile.
scenes.visual: A cheerful green frog sitting on a lily pad close to the rock, looking upward with bright friendly eyes, charming macro perspective.

scenes.narration: Please play more, the frog croaked gently. Your stones make the water dance and help us all feel peaceful.
scenes.visual: An otter looking surprised and delighted as a tiny frog near the water creates little ripples of its own, warm friendly atmosphere.

scenes.narration: Oliver beamed with joy. He tossed another smooth pebble into the current, creating a lovely rhythm.
scenes.visual: An otter tossing a stone with a joyful expression, water splashing in sparkling crystal droplets, bright uplifting colors.

scenes.narration: Soon, frogs and dragonflies joined the gentle tune, turning the quiet evening river into a symphony of happiness.
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a peaceful river at twilight filled with floating lily pads and glowing fireflies, magical tranquil mood.

scenes.narration: Your unique voice and special talents bring joy to the world just by being yourself. Rest well.
scenes.visual: An otter floating comfortably on its back in calm water under a starry night sky, closed eyes, peaceful sleepy expression.

scenes.narration: We share a brand new gentle story every single day. Follow along for more heartwarming bedtime tales.
scenes.visual: A cozy riverbank scene under moonlight with gentle twinkling stars, comforting bedtime aesthetic, soft glowing illumination.
